rows.status: Adopted as Resolution No. HR00158 on 2011-08-24

first_reading.sub_name: BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE, WAYS AND MEANS

second_reading.adopted_resolution_title: RESOLUTION URGING THE EXECUTIVE BRANCH OF GOVERNMENT TO PRIORITIZE THE URGRADING OF STANDARDS OF BASIC EDUCATION IN THE PHILIPPINES

committee_action.meethigh:
Discussions on the measure:

â€¢This will offer an optimum investment to promote nation building and effectively cultivate development through education. 

â€¢This will help address the huge backlog of school buildings, facilities and equipment and modern instructional materials.

â€¢The funding will be based on the unpaid Internal Revenue Allotment (IRA) due the local government units as of December 31, 2010 which is approximately Php 400 Billion pesos.

â€¢The project implementation will be by the LGUs in coordination with the DILG and DepEd.

â€¢Newly upgraded school facilities may be procured and distributed by June 2013 start of classes if the project will be executed by December 2011.

Agreements reached:

Revise the provisions of the resolution to present an encouraging context that will entice and promote partnership between the LGUs and the executive branch in undertaking the construction, rehabilitation and maintenance of school buildings and other school facilities and the procurement of IT equipment for the upgrading of basic education.

Insert the provision - THAT LOANS CONTRACTED FOR SUCH PURPOSES SHALL BE PAYABLE BY THE NATIONAL GOVERNMENT CHARGEABLE AGAINST THE FORTY PERCENT (40%) SHARE OF THE LGUS FROM THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE TAXES COLLECTED BY THE BUREAU OF CUSTOMS FOR THE YEARS 1992 TO THE PRESENT".
